objective: Integrate the validated local document pipeline as a derived, cacheable, rollback-capable production support path while preserving authoritative-PDF semantic authority.
authority_invariants: ACQUIRE commits authoritative source bytes and database identity before any sidecar compile.
Sidecar failure is fail-open for ACQUIRE and is reported as FAILED_DERIVED_SIDECAR.
EXTRACT and VERIFY remain STANDARD semantic jobs using authoritative-PDF ResearchContextHydrator.
Paper-package sidecars never silently replace semantic hydration.

cache_contract.smoke_requirement: one uncached preserved PDF must produce COMPLETED followed by CACHE_HIT

routing_contract: Docling standard_no_ocr provides structure/table FAST package.
Formula pages detected by standard structure may use the shared CodeFormulaV2 broker.
FAST empty table grids escalate to targeted TableFormer ACCURATE.
Paddle table crop is allowed only when the targeted ACCURATE page still has no non-empty table grid.
No OCR or general document VLM is introduced.
bounded_daemon_gate: PostgreSQL must have no RUNNING research run and no QUEUED/RUNNING non-HUMAN job before daemon start.
Scientific tables are fingerprinted before sidecar smoke/daemon start and after daemon stop.
Daemon starts only for a finite idle health interval.
Exactly one DETERMINISTIC, CHEAP, STANDARD, and STRONG worker associated with the daemon MainPID must register ACTIVE.
No formula/table model-server subprocess may exist during the idle daemon interval.
Daemon is stopped unconditionally by trap and must end inactive/dead PID 0.
Scientific table fingerprints must remain identical.
Only derived cache files, document_sidecar_events, and worker/ops telemetry may change.
pass_condition: Sidecar miss->hit, telemetry, idle daemon worker registration, cleanup, and scientific fingerprint invariance all pass.
